svg.aria-label: Publishing sequence: you ask for a draft; Claude calls draft_post and your Worker saves it for 24 hours and returns a preview; Claude shows you the exact preview; only when you say publish does Claude call publish_post, your Worker posts to LinkedIn, saves the record and returns the link.
svg.text: POSTLINE · PUBLISHING A POST, TWO TURNS ON PURPOSE

g.text: nothing posts until you say so
